objective.primary: Increase breakout probability by combining the strongest posting windows with higher-recognition film/series IPs, stronger first-second hooks, and a non-Globo YouTube lane.
objective.note: 70k likes on 100k views equals a 70% like rate and remains an extraordinary stretch; retention, shares and comments remain leading indicators.
